svg.title: What the EHR keeps from an ECG
svg.desc: Panel a shows a ten-second single-lead ECG waveform. Panel b enlarges one beat with the PR interval, QRS duration, and QT interval bracketed, beside a box listing the few measured values and the interpretation text that reach the structured EHR record. Synthetic waveform.
svg.text: Full waveform: one lead, 10 s at 500 Hz. Lives in the cardiology information system (e.g., MUSE), not the EHR database.
One beat, enlarged: the intervals that are measured
What reaches the structured EHR record
“Normal sinus rhythm. No acute ST changes.”
